config.title: VB4
config.language: UI language of the extension. Use 'VB4: Select Language' to choose a built-in or imported language.
config.openGameQuickLoad: Quick load when launching the game (F8): temporarily hide the intro/splash videos and restore them when the game exits (like Sanny Builder). Only applies to GTA SA.
config.colorsEnabled: Turns the per-category syntax coloring on/off (read from a krauber.ini-style .ini file).
config.colorsIniPath: Path to the .ini file with the syntax colors (krauber.ini format, [syntax] section). Empty = the theme imported via 'VB4: Import SB4 Theme', else <SB4 folder>\krauber.ini.
config.coordinateDecimals: Number of decimals for the X, Y and Z coordinates inserted with Ctrl+Shift+C.
config.angleDecimals: Number of decimals for the Z angle inserted with Ctrl+Shift+E.
